info.name: Rithu Snacks API
info.description:
Auto-generated Postman collection covering all API routes in the rithu-snacks Next.js app (generated from the `monisha` branch).

**Authentication**: Login/Register set httpOnly `access_token` / `refresh_token` cookies. Run 'Auth > Login' first -- Postman's cookie jar carries the session to subsequent requests automatically. Alternatively, set the `accessToken` collection variable and enable the (disabled) Authorization header on a request to use Bearer-token auth instead.

Set the `baseUrl` variable to your running dev server (default http://localhost:3000).

**Notes on a few endpoints**: `/api/cart` (POST), `/api/orders` (GET/POST) and `/api/checkout/summary` (POST) import Zod schemas that do not actually exist at their stated import path in the current codebase (likely legacy routes superseded by `/api/customer/cart` and `/api/customer/orders`) -- their example bodies here are best-effort guesses; verify against `orderService`/`cartService` before relying on them. `/api/admin/reset-database` (POST) has NO auth check at all and truncates the database -- see its request description.

item.name: 🛍️ Customer App -- By Page (start here)
item.description: One folder per real storefront page (src/app/(store)/**), listing exactly the API calls that page makes -- traced from the actual frontend code, not guessed from route names. The 'Admin' / 'Customer' / 'Staff' / etc. folders below list every API route grouped by backend resource, for reference.
